mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is a leading indicator of positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as historically low rates have been associated with equity market gains.
evidence_refs: fact:Current FEDFUNDS value (0.16%) is historically low
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS is observed.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns due to economic contraction fears.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 215, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns due to stagflation risks.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 215.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (as indicated by GDP growth above $13,000 billion), the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns due to overvaluation and policy tightening.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 > 13000.

mechanism_narrative: When employment (PAYEMS) falls below 130,000, the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns due to economic weakness.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS < 130000.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is below 100 and housing starts (HOUST) are below 570, the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns due to supply-demand mismatch.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 100 AND HOUST < 570.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 360,000, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns due to strong consumer demand.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS > 360000.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 215, the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns due to immediate market reactions to high inflation.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 215.
